mods.name: MobWalk
mods.description: Shows where a chosen mob can stand and walk, marking inescapable holes, and hazards like lava and soul sand.

releases.notes:
Version: 1.1.0, for Minecraft 26.2
- Auto Update: recalculate walkable surfaces on an interval.
- Distribute calculations across frames to reduce stuttering.

Version: 1.0.0
- Initial release. A client-side overlay that paints where a chosen mob can stand and walk from a wand-selected block.
- Marks inescapable holes and hazards (water, lava, soul sand, magma).
- Built-in mobs such as Player, Ravager, and Warden, plus custom profiles (width, height, and vertical reach).
- Colors, hazard markers, the wand item, and visibility are all configurable.

readmeSummary: A client-side Fabric mod that shows where a chosen mob can safely stand and walk.
